title: Captured run before halting
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be a configuration of $D$ on input $x$, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. If the run of $D$ from $c$ is not halted at any step $s<t$, then running the timed conditional machine for $t$ steps from the control configuration associated with $c$ yields the control configuration associated with the configuration reached by $D$ after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $D,M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
For every $s<t$, the configuration of $D$ reached after $s$ steps from $c$ is not halted
